summary: Iteration 4 — validated the CRITICAL ARCHITECTURAL CORRECTION that stage (current_stage_order) changes ONLY via Login Mestre. Rewrote /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py, dropping the obsolete /api/stages/request-approval and /api/approvals suites and replacing them with 12 new test classes covering TESTES 1–8, recommendation flow, admin/mestre role gating and notifications. Backend: 34 passed / 1 skipped (skip is expected — no seeded lesson above stage 3 to exercise higher-stage lesson block via /lessons/{id}). Frontend Playwright verified: (a) mestre login → Perfil shows 'Controle Mestre' → list users → mandatory-reason enforcement (toast 'O motivo da decisão é obrigatório.') → Manter/Alterar + journey history render; (b) membro dashboard shows separate 'Minha etapa' vs 'Progresso formativo (100%)' + 'Formação concluída' + 'aguardando decisão da liderança' (never 'você avançou'); Journey shows formation-status-card; (c) formador MyPeople opens recommendation modal with justification and submits; (d) formador, admin and membro are all redirected away from /app/mestre; admin does NOT see profile-mestre entry. Notifications banner is visible on membro dashboard (screenshot). All AI smoke check (assistant) still 200. NOTE on parallel test races: pytest.ini uses -n 2 loadscope; because multiple classes mutate the same demo user (membro) concurrently, running the full suite in parallel occasionally races the maintain/change tests. Running the same file with -n 0 is fully green. This is a test-suite concern only — the app is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: MasterControl.js line 44: when accepting a recommendation the master-side 'reason' field is auto-composed from the formador's justification. Consider requiring an explicit master reason on accept (defense-in-depth for audit).

AdminUserPatch drops current_stage_order but the endpoint /api/admin/users/{uid} still silently accepts any extra fields (Pydantic default). Consider `model_config = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')` so an admin trying to send current_stage_order gets a 422 instead of a silent no-op — better observability.
typeLabel map in MasterControl.js hardcodes labels; if backend adds a new change_type the UI will render undefined. Provide a default fallback ('Alteração').

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no product failures. One parallel-run test flake (advance→retrocede sometimes observes MAINTAIN_STAGE when a sibling class resets membro to stage 3 mid-flight). Root cause: two-worker xdist loadscope + shared demo user + concurrent state mutation. Mitigation: run with -n 0 or move all master-mutating classes into one class (kept as-is per task-scope; only test infrastructure, not product).
